checks.name: pinned engine: Apache Spark 4.3.0
the panel prints both formatted plans, and they match with ids set aside
explain(True) prints all four phases
the DataFrame and SQL forms give the same answer
SQL and DataFrame code reach the same optimised plan
and the same physical plan
the SQL's parsed plan names its table unresolved; analysis finds it
DataFrame code is analysed as each line is written: its plan already carries types and ids (x#n)
a misspelt column fails at analysis, on its own line, before any job
the optimiser adds a step nobody wrote: isnotnull(x)
the optimised plan still has the Filter over the whole relation: pushdown and the two-column read are decided in physical planning
the optimiser keeps only what the query needs: a Project of clinic over the filter
written after the count, the filter runs before it: the optimiser moves it below the aggregate
the scan reads 2 of the table's 4 columns (pruning)
the filter is pushed into the scan
the physical plan splits the count around an Exchange: partial, then final
explain() before any action shows the starting plan
the UDF version gives the same answer
with the UDF, a Python node evaluates the filter and nothing about x is pushed down
over Spark Connect, DataFrame code waits until its plan is first needed; a SQL string still fails at once
the panel's first five statements run no job: building, comparing and explaining plans moves no rows
the UDF line reads every patient and sends each one to Python
with pushdown, only the row groups whose statistics allow x = 1 are read
without pushdown every row group is read
the column data the query needs is a small part of the file's
the UDF version reads every row: its filter can't be pushed down
